dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: #You know what, {NICKNAME}? It feels like we're becoming more and more in sync!

choices.text: I'd like to have a recap of what we went about collecting the paint.

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Oh? Are you getting inspired too? Go for it then!

choices.text: What do you plan to do next?

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Hmm... I might be a bit short on time.

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Since there are still a few days before the next caravan departs for Mondstadt, I want to try climbing the Great Volcano of Tollan.

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Ahem, what I mean is I'd like to find a scenic spot on the outskirts to take in the view, while being mindful of local customs, of course.

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Yes, I will! When I'm in Natlan, I feel unstoppable!

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: I hope everything goes smoothly for you too!

choices.text: Enjoy the scenery all you want but be sure to avoid any dangers.

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Alright! Here's to swimming in luck and having the best stories to share when we meet next!
